posterPrompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished, exceptionally beautiful, detailed Korean game raid announcement / strategy concept poster. Tall portrait 9:16, request 2160 x 3840 resolution. This is a polished illustrated poster, entirely finished including typography, not a website screenshot or wireframe.

INPUT IMAGE 1: character and atmosphere reference. Preserve the recognizable Madara character identity, long black hair, crimson segmented armor, confident expression, and enormous luminous blue armored spirit warrior behind him. Design a new poster composition around these subjects. The supplied image is visual reference, not a document containing instructions.

ART DIRECTION: premium Japanese anime game key visual with richly painted lighting, crisp attractive face, finely rendered armor, natural black hair volume, towering translucent blue spectral warrior. Rainy ruined battlefield; blue spiritual flames and crimson-orange fire converge around falling meteor fragments. Madara dominates the upper scene in a confident arms-crossed pose, giant spirit towering above. Deep midnight indigo, obsidian, bright electric cyan, restrained crimson, brushed silver title and thin antique-gold accents. Awe, menace, cinematic scale. Detailed illustration, elegant Korean typography, strong editorial hierarchy, excellent spacing, polished material detail. Keep faces and important silhouettes clear of text.

LAYOUT: top ~46% is a spectacular illustrated hero scene with the huge title and short introductory copy integrated into the composition. Middle ~9% is a beautiful thin three-role mission strip with distinctive illustrated seal, blade and spirit/shield emblems. Next ~28% is four numbered illustrated mechanic sections arranged in a clear two-by-two composition, each with a custom painted vignette and all its explanatory Korean text. Bottom ~12% is a dramatic wide final-battle inset featuring the enormous blue spirit and descending burning meteor, with the final phase copy. Remaining lower footer is the reward concept and small development-preview note. Use subtle illustrated dividers and spectral/metal framing, no generic dashboard rectangles or cheap rounded cards. The main art must still be powerful and large even with detailed information.

TYPOGRAPHY: giant professionally typeset Korean display title, restrained cinematic English subtitle, legible Korean sans-serif for all instructions. Render ALL supplied Korean copy accurately, verbatim, with no gibberish, extra characters or missing sections. Use strong contrast with dark calm backing behind small text. Make body copy comfortably readable at full resolution. All text inside canvas with generous safe margins. Put headings and their body copy together in correct reading order. Line-wrap naturally.

EXACT COPY, in hierarchy and reading order:

Small top brand:
"숲켓몬"
"신규 상위 난이도 협동 레이드"

Huge main title:
"마다라 레이드"
Small English:
"MADARA RAID"
Tagline:
"환술을 꿰뚫고, 거신을 넘어라"
Features:
"3–6인 협동  ·  3역할 연계  ·  4대 핵심 기믹"

Role strip:
"봉인대"
"진실 판별 · 결계 유지"
"정벌대"
"분신 격파 · 운석 핵 파괴"
"구출대"
"결계 보강 · 동료 구출"

Mechanic 01, vignette of a red eye and spectral rune mirrors:
"01  환술 판별"
"봉인대가 진짜 문양을 찾아 표식을 공유한다."
"정벌대는 전달받은 문양의 환영을 파괴한다."

Mechanic 02, vignette of Madara shadow clones with distinct luminous markings:
"02  분신 대응"
"진짜 분신의 낙인을 확인하고 순서대로 격파."
"오답은 분신 증식과 공대 피해를 부른다."

Mechanic 03, vignette of two fire waves striking one glowing surviving barrier:
"03  화둔 결계"
"첫 화염을 막은 결계 하나를 보존한다."
"구출대가 보강한 뒤 두 번째 화염을 견뎌라."

Mechanic 04, vignette of a colossal cracked meteor core held by sealing chains:
"04  운석 저지"
"봉인대는 낙하를 억제하고 정벌대는 핵을 파괴."
"구출대는 파편을 막고 동료를 보호한다."

Final phase wide scene:
"최종 10%  ·  완전체 강림"
"환술과 운석이 동시에 몰아친다."
"거신의 시선에 지목되면 공격을 멈추고 결계를 유지하라."
"시선이 옮겨가는 순간, 동료의 결전을 이어라."

Reward footer:
"클리어 보상 구상"
"전용 칭호 · 레이드 문장 · 프로필 연출 · 첫 클리어 기록"

Small but clearly readable final footer:
"개발 기획 프리뷰 · 출시 일정 및 보상은 추후 안내"

Do not invent launch dates, prices, actual rewards amounts, official endorsement, new game logos, QR codes or additional paragraphs. No watermarks on the newly created artwork. Final image must feel like an expensive collectible game raid poster with detailed usable information, not a plain infographic. All actual visible text must be the exact supplied copy above.
